cards.name: Shove
cards.text: Shove an enemy next to you a tile back and spin it round: its back is to you. A strike it had readied falls through and it is exposed. Strong arms shove two tiles.

cards.name: Flank Step
cards.text: Slip up to two tiles, no AP, and turn to the nearest enemy you see: get round to its side or back before you strike.

cards.name: Yank
cards.text: Reaction to a seen enemy's readied strike, within 3 tiles: yank it a tile toward you. Its strike falls through and it is exposed.

cards.name: Spoil
cards.text: Reaction to a seen enemy's readied strike, within 4 tiles: call it off where it stands, even on what cannot be moved. The enemy is exposed: your side's next hit on it lands harder.

cards.name: Drag In
cards.text: Drag an enemy within 3 tiles two tiles toward you: into your reach, or onto a blow already coming down. Breaks its strike.

cards.name: Switch Places
cards.text: Trade places with an ally within 2 tiles: pull them out of a blow and take their tile, or put your fighter up front.

cards.name: Go Now!
cards.text: An ally who has not acted yet this turn round goes next. It never gets an extra turn, only an earlier one.

cards.name: Feint
cards.text: A seen enemy that has not acted yet this turn round goes last: your people move first, out of its way.

cards.name: Barricade
cards.text: Throw up cover on an open tile next to you, for this round and the next.

cards.name: Smoke Bomb
cards.text: A smoke screen over a seen tile within 5 and the tiles round it (not over yourself), for this round and the next: nobody sees or shoots through it, or into it from further than a step.

cards.name: Second Wind
cards.text: You or an ally within 2 tiles gets 1 AP more this turn.

cards.name: Snap Strike
cards.text: Strike an enemy in reach now with your best attack, for no AP. Fighters only.

cards.name: Dash
cards.text: One more tile of move range this turn. Spend 1 AP for another.

cards.name: Sprint
cards.text: Two more tiles of move range. Runners only.

cards.name: Steady Aim
cards.text: +10% to hit on your next attack; more for trained shooters.

cards.name: Heavy Swing
cards.text: +10% to hit on your next attack. Needs working arms. 1 AP more for another 10%.

cards.name: Called Shot
cards.text: +25% to hit on your next attack, for 1 AP. Marksmen only; needs working arms.

cards.name: Take Cover
cards.text: +15% cover until your next turn.

cards.name: Roll With It
cards.text: The next hit you take lands a tier lighter.

cards.name: Hold the Line
cards.text: The next hit you take lands two tiers lighter. Tough fighters only.

cards.name: Field Dressing
cards.text: Takes 10% off your worst injury; more in trained hands. Used up.

cards.name: Scout Ahead
cards.text: Draw two cards.

cards.name: Sidestep
cards.text: Reaction to a seen enemy's readied strike: the next hit you take lands a tier lighter, and one more tile of move range.

cards.name: Counterstrike
cards.text: Reaction to a seen enemy's readied strike: strike that enemy first when its blow comes, if it is in reach.
